correctness.rationale: For unnormalized Nystrom leave-one-out on A=I_n and 2<=m<=n, each B_j=m-1+Y_j, with Y_j~chi-square_nu and nu=n-m+1. Conditioning on other m-2 columns leaves two independent d=nu+1 Gaussian residual vectors whose independent radii share one sin^2 angle with Beta((d-1)/2,1/2) law. Its first and second beta moments yield Cov(B_i,B_j)=2nu/(nu+3) and correlation 1/(nu+3), not independent basic estimates. Exchangeability then gives Var(T_m)=2nu(n+3)/(m(nu+3)), E J_m=2nu(nu+2)/(m(nu+3)) and ratio (n+3)/(nu+2). At m=n, true absolute-error variance approaches 1/2 while J_m tends to zero in probability. Bounding fourth moment by 848 and Cauchy–Schwarz yields liminf event probability >=1/13568; m>=n+1 gives exact identity projector via pseudoinverse. Independent exact rational beta/variance checks passed; finite checks do not prove the limit.
